title: Everyone has a job to do
takeaway: Young people, farmers, workers and soldiers each have a part in building a country.
scene: The title means 'The work of the young'. In four lines the poet lists what each group of people should do for the country.

original: ہمت نال تقدیر نوں بدل دینا میری قوم دے شیر جواناں دا کم
بھکھ ننگ دی الکھ مکا دینی میرے دیش دے ویر کساناں دا کم
transliteration: Himmat naal taqdeer nu badal dena meri qaum de sher javaanaan da kam
Bhukh nang di alakh muka deni mere desh de veer kisaanaan da kam
translation: Changing destiny with courage is the job of my nation's lion-hearted young people.
Ending hunger and poverty for good is the job of my country's brother farmers.
couplets.story: Young people's job is to change the country's future through courage. Farmers' job is to make sure nobody goes hungry or without clothes.

original: روشن جگ تے وطن دا نام کرنا محنت کش دلیر انساناں دا کم
جان وطن توں احمدؔ قربان کرنا پاک فوج دے پاسباناں دا کم
transliteration: Roshan jag te vatan da naam karna mehnat-kash daler insaanaan da kam
Jaan vatan ton Ahmad qurbaan karna Paak fauj de paasbaanaan da kam
translation: Making the homeland's name shine in the world is the job of brave, hard-working people.
Ahmad, giving one's life for the homeland is the job of the guardians in Pakistan's army.
couplets.story: Hard-working people make the country's name shine around the world. The soldiers who guard the country are ready to give their lives for it.

why: A simple picture of a country where everyone, young people, farmers, workers and soldiers, has a part to play.
prompt: What's your 'job' in making your community better?
